title: AIS AuthN (operator-managed) Chart Values
description: Types the values this chart owns. The blocks that map onto AIStoreAuthSpec are only checked for shape: their contents are passed through to the CRD, whose schema and validating webhook validate them.

persistentVolume.description: Chart-only. Creates a local PersistentVolume for persistence. Rendered only when hostPath is set.

reclaimPolicy.description: Reclaim policy for the created volume. Defaults to Retain, the only policy that keeps AuthN's users and RSA keys once the claim goes away.

nodeAffinity.description: Pin a local volume to specific nodes.

secretRef.description: Reference to a Secret managed outside this chart.
